rules.title: Force Play
rules.description: Transcribed from src/match/rules/force_play.cpp. Legacy OnCardDrawn sets CardDrawnEvent::force_play, so the draw flow auto-plays a just-drawn playable card instead of prompting DecideDrawnCardEffect (src/match/match_instance.cpp:699-727). Phase-1 equivalent: an after:draw hook branches on the WP9d drawn_card_playable predicate; when the drawn card is playable the WP9d play_card op submits the frame-bound @drawn_card as @self, and the engine routes that through the normal play pipeline (restriction -> before:play -> move -> after:play). When it is not playable the card stays in hand.
